name: SPT-CL J2215-3537 (Hubble)
blurb: SPT-CL J2215-3537, a massive galaxy cluster found by the South Pole Telescope, seen by Hubble.
label: sptclj22153537-hubble
story: A massive galaxy cluster first found by the South Pole Telescope. Hubble's snapshot adds to a census of such clusters across cosmic time, from the galaxies in their crowded cores to faint lensed galaxies far behind them.

claims.text: SPT-CL J2215-3537 is one of the South Pole Telescope galaxy clusters imaged in Hubble program 15307
The program's clusters were identified via the Sunyaev-Zel'dovich effect and are massive clusters
The program studies the growth of brightest cluster galaxies through mergers, strong lensing, and lensed background galaxies
